title: 星絨法師：自走遠征
revisedBehavior: Every existing bag and legacy basket item is kept in one growing backpack.
At most 30 bag item cards rendered per page; selection is ID-based with explicit sale confirmation.
Whole-build combat power replacement comparisons drive highlight and current-to-after preview.
World coordinates and an exact hero-follow camera replace the stationary arena.
Three enemies maximum; NW/NE/SE arrivals begin offscreen 3.8 seconds apart.
A reserved southwest corridor and physical retreat lead to the last safe camp.
limits: Combat power is a comparative build index, not a guarantee of winning or exact DPS.
Five visual regions cycle with depth; five finite skills, rank10 each.
No automatic allocation/equipping; unattended builds can plateau while safely farming.
No offline gains. Browser memory/storage quotas still apply to a growing inventory.
Import safety limit32MiB; level999 and depth9999 maximum.
